```{r,echo=FALSE}

nouns = c("apples","bugs","cats","dogs","elephants","flowers","giraffes","hawks","insects","jaguars","kangaroos","llamas","mice","narwhals","owls","ponies","quokkas","snakes","tulips","umbrellas","violins","whales","xylophones","zebras")

adjectives = c("awesome","blue","curious","dangerous","enigmatic","furious","green","happy","indigo","jealous","killers","lame","menacing","nice","outgoing","pious","queens","red","sly","transient","umpires","violent","weak","xenophobic","yellow","zombies")

phrases = c("All XXX are YYY.","No XXX are YYY.","Some XXX are YYY.","Some XXX are not YYY.")

explains = c("$A$ is a subset of $B$.","$A$ and $B$ are disjoint.","the intersection of $A$ and $B$ is not empty.","$A$ is not a subset of $B$.")

n = sample(nouns,1)
a = sample(adjectives,1)

phrases = gsub("XXX",n,phrases,fixed=T)
phrases = gsub("YYY",a,phrases,fixed=T)


explains = gsub("XXX",n,explains,fixed=T)
explains = gsub("YYY",a,explains,fixed=T)

i1 = sample(1:4,1)
p1 = phrases[i1]
p2 = phrases[5-i1]

e1 = explains[i1]
e2 = explains[5-i1]

ach = sample(phrases)
al = paste0("* ",ach,collapse="\n")
sol = paste0(1*(ach==p2),collapse="")


```

Question
========

Let $p$ represent the quantified logical statement below.

$$p: \text{ `r p1`}$$

Which of the following represents the [negation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Negation#Negations_of_quantifiers) of $p$? In other words, which represents $\sim p$?

Answerlist
--------

`r al`


Solution
========

Let set $A$ represent the set of all things classified as `r n`.

Let set $B$ represent the set of all things classified as `r a`.

Statement $p$ says that `r e1`

The logical negation, $\sim p$ would be that `r e2`

Thus,

$$\sim p: \text{ `r p2`}$$
